description: Removes one 'not in the email' verdict from a parsed email, as the facts-review panel's Undo does. email_id is the email the verdict was made on and correction_id comes from the correction you read. It only removes a verdict this way; a corrected value is changed by correcting the field again. Only 'not in the email' verdicts can be undone. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat after it is gone answers success.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: undo_email_fact_correction
title: Undo a 'not in the email' verdict
